long_biography.plain_text:
Ball spent the early part of his finance career in sales and trading, progressing through Lehman Brothers, Bear Stearns and Banco Santander to managing-director responsibilities. He then built specialist investment platforms serving private and institutional capital across Latin America. He became a co-founder and managing partner of Guggenheim Investment Advisors before co-chairing Guggenheim Partners Latin America.

LJ Capital and ABS Holdings extended that founder-led model; ABS operates as a private investment group with offices in Miami, London and Montevideo. Ball has paired this cross-border investing work with institutional service in Argentina. He sits on the governing council of MALBA and chairs Fundación Germinare, whose education programmes support students from underserved communities.

uncertainties.detail: Juan Ball is a common name, and LinkedIn search results contain numerous namesakes. Resolution is nevertheless conclusive because the source record already contains the exact Miami ABS Capital LinkedIn URL, while separate first-party sources name the same Juan Ball as owner of both source-record yachts. The 1961 birth year, Argentine nationality, United States residence, finance affiliations and independent sailing biography provide additional matching anchors.

The Argentine Official Gazette republication describes Ball and his co-founder as Argentine nationals but does not state where Ball was born. Nationality is not a substitute for birthplace, so place_of_birth and birth_country remain unproposed.

The exact day appears in Dateas' verbatim republication of an Argentine Official Gazette incorporation notice rather than on the current official gazette domain. Companies House independently confirms January 1961 and the source record confirms 1961; this convergence supports the proposed day at very-high rather than conclusive confidence.

Ball demonstrably progressed from banking employment to co-founding the investment businesses associated with his wealth. The reviewed evidence does not document whether family wealth, status or networks materially shaped his starting position, so broad Self-made avoids inventing either an independent or advantaged start.

The CAMPO biography renders Ball's United States investment company as ABC Capco LLC, while the source LinkedIn and official company website use ABS Capital Company, LLC and the public-company proxy uses ABS Holdings. The biography avoids assigning him a disputed current chief-executive title; the proposed known-for title uses the proxy's exact co-founder and co-chairman wording.

The source record already contains the exact supported LinkedIn profile, so it is not duplicated. No sufficiently verified personal Instagram or personal website was found. The ABS website and CAMPO profile are retained as evidence sources rather than misrepresented as person-controlled social accounts.

Asset management, Investment banking and Competitive sailing are the minimum useful approved active tags supported by sustained, role-specific evidence. Art collector is also plausible from the CAMPO biography and MALBA patronage, but the evidence does not show that collecting is substantial enough to require a fourth tag.
